limitations: Diagnostic parsed-Viper replay, separate from the original direct-Prusti timings.
One capture per backend while adoption suites and ordinary background processes continue; no controlled end-to-end speed ratio.
Resource limits are enabled; no SMT wall-clock timeout option was emitted.
Query waits include relay/pipe/scheduling costs; query intervals and phases are not exclusive CPU accounting.
Native and source owner/worker solver contexts are different; equal quantifier/pattern counts do not establish equivalent formulas or histories.
Two solver-only replays per stream in opposite backend orders have stable work counters but variable CPU and wall times.
Offline traces follow a fixed recorded decision path; all original responses are checked rather than rerunning verifier decisions.
Relay metadata lacks final exit fields because verifiers terminate relays; outer supervisors report no pending cleanup and command/response audits are complete.
